shared_elements: relief carving in low raised relief on a large upright stone slab
repeated row of small motifs along the upper edge
standing/upright figures in the upper zone
justification: Both are large upright slabs bearing low-relief imagery organised into an upper zone of repeated small motifs above a horizontal band, with figural content below, which gives a loose arrangement correspondence. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows human-form figures beneath a winged sun-like emblem above dense ruled lines of script-like signs, while B shows animals in profile (a quadruped, a snake-like or lizard-like creature, a large bird with folded wings) with no script and no human figures, rendered in a far more schematic, isolated-silhouette manner.
